verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own GitHub sync imports a repository's GitHub issues and can keep them in sync in both directions, so tickets from an external system (GitHub) can be viewed and managed inside GitCafe. That is the only external tracker evidenced. The pack shows no integration with dedicated trackers such as Jira or Linear, and nothing on linking or opening external tickets from a pull request. Missing for 10: integrations with dedicated external issue trackers, ticket references or links surfaced on pull requests, independent corroboration.
